<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Parameter MUL2_DIV_CLK is used to determine the number of clock cycles for division.
        parameter [2:0] MUL2_DIV_CLK = 7;
        
        // Internal signals for clock generation
        reg [2:0] cnt_clk_div;
        reg div_clk;
        reg div_clk_dly;
        reg div_clk_dly2;
        wire [2:0] next_cnt_clk_div;
        reg [2:0] cnt_next_clk_div;
        
        // Combinational logic for calculating the next count value based on current count
        assign next_cnt_clk_div[2] = cnt_clk_div[2];
        assign next_cnt_clk_div[1] = ~cnt_clk_div[1] & ~cnt_clk_div[0];
        assign next_cnt_clk_div[0] = ~cnt_clk_div[1] ^ cnt_clk_div[0];
        
        // Sequential logic for updating the count and clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt_clk_div <= 0;
                div_clk <= 0;
            end else begin
                cnt_clk_div <= next_cnt_clk_div;
                div_clk <= |next_cnt_clk_div;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for generating delayed clock signals
        always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt_next_clk_div <= 0;
                div_clk_dly <= 0;
            end else begin
                cnt_next_clk_div <= next_cnt_clk_div;
                div_clk_dly <= |cnt_next_clk_div;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for further delaying the clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                div_clk_dly2 <= 0;
            end else begin
                div_clk_dly2 <= div_clk_dly;
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment for the fractionally divided clock
        assign clk_div = div_clk | div_clk_dly2;
    </implementation>
</module>
